title: UPPAAi: Towards LLM-Assisted Modeling, Verification, Analysis and Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2610.40042v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For more than three decades, UPPAAL has supported the modelling and analysis of real-time and cyber-physical systems. Yet building a suitable model, formalising the intended properties, choosing analysis techniques and interpreting counterexamples remain iterative tasks that demand substantial expertise. Large language models (LLMs) can offer plausible explanations and even solutions, but they are not necessarily correct. We present UPPAAI, an extension of UPPAAL in which users construct, explain, debug and specify models in dialogue with an LLM. The guiding principle is that the user requests, the LLM proposes, explains and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies. UPPAAI exposes the UPPAAL editor, queries and verifier through a Tools API. We report on seven case studies, from explaining to a newcomer to learning a controller, covering timed automata, stochastic hybrid automata and strategy learning. translated_title: UPPAAi：迈向大语言模型辅助的建模、验证、分析与综合
translated_abstract: 三十多年来，UPPAAL一直支持对实时系统和信息物理系统进行建模与分析。然而，构建合适的模型、形式化预期的性质、选择分析技术以及解释反例，仍然是需要大量专业知识的迭代性任务。大语言模型（LLM）可以提供看似合理的解释甚至解决方案，但它们并不一定正确。我们提出了UPPAAI，这是UPPAAL的一个扩展，用户可以在与大语言模型的对话中构建、解释、调试和规约模型。其指导原则是：用户提出请求，大语言模型进行提议、解释和编排，而由UPPAAL进行验证。UPPAAI通过工具API（Tools API）对外暴露UPPAAL的编辑器、查询和验证器。我们报告了七个案例研究，从向新手进行讲解到学习控制器，涵盖了时间自动机、随机混合自动机和策略学习。事实证明，大语言模型在其中极有帮助。
tldr: UPPAAI将大语言模型与UPPAAL形式化验证工具相结合，遵循“用户请求、LLM提议与编排、UPPAAL验证”的原则，借助工具API实现了LLM辅助的实时与信息物理系统建模、验证、分析与综合，弥补了LLM输出不保证正确的缺陷。
en_tdlr: UPPAAI extends UPPAAL by integrating LLMs through a Tools API, following the principle "the user requests, the LLM proposes and orchestrates, and UPPAAL verifies," enabling LLM-assisted modeling, verification, analysis and synthesis of real-time and cyber-physical systems while ensuring correctness via formal verification.
